WEBSITE INFORMATION

Privacy, plainly explained.

This notice describes this pre-launch website. A separate product privacy notice will be needed before live account connections become available.

Planned capabilities · product in development

UPDATED 25 OCTOBER 2026

What this website collects

The enquiry form prepares a note on your device. It does not submit your entries to a server. Details remain in the current page until you reload or close it. Downloading the note saves a text file on your device. A contact address will be added once confirmed.

Interactive examples

The dashboard uses fictional sample data. The calculator runs in your browser. Neither connects to Amazon or Xero, and calculator inputs are not transmitted by this website.

Cookies and hosting

This website code does not set analytics or advertising cookies and does not use third-party analytics scripts. The hosting provider may process technical request information and apply its own access or authentication mechanisms.

Email enquiries

Only include information needed to discuss the product. Do not send account passwords, access tokens or customer order records. A contact route and details of the service operator will be published before enquiries open.

Before the product launches

The product’s legal operator, account-data processing, retention arrangements and applicable rights information will be confirmed in the service privacy notice before customer integrations open.
